During the trip, the caravan stopped at a circus.

When Hikaru took a liking to a rare sabre-toothed tiger, Chamū, which was featured there, Michiru ended up purchasing not only it, but the rest of the circus as well, placing it under the team's protection.

outro.fallback: Upset by Naruto's view of him, Hikaru went out to help Chamū get to safety, and Naruto saved both of them after they were washed overboard.
The next day, Naruto, Sakura and Lee become friends with Hikaru.
